note: LM catalog for the cascade (STT -> LM -> TTS) engine. Change `default` to switch the model every cascade persona uses; add entries to `models` to make more available (no live API list needed). A persona can also pin a model via `lmModelId` in lib/realtime/cascade-agent.ts. `backends[*].envKey` names a fnox/env secret read server-side in app/api/llm/route.ts — values never reach the browser; an empty envKey marks a keyless backend (local server) and no Authorization header is sent. `supportsThinking` sends chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking:false (reasoning models); leave false for APIs that reject unknown fields (Mistral 422s, and the HF router now rejects it with wrong_api_format). `extraBody` merges backend-specific fields into the upstream request (the tinker backend uses it to send reasoning_effort:none — Inkling is a hybrid reasoning model and would otherwise think at effort 0.9 before the first spoken token; its reasoning streams on reasoning_content, which the client ignores). HF models pick an inference provider with a `:provider` suffix (e.g. `:fastest`, `:cerebras`). Tinker model ids come from https://tinker-docs.thinkingmachines.ai/tinker/models.json; `:peft:262144` = 256K context, `:sampling-nvfp4` = the serverless-inference tier (beta, Inkling only). The `local` backend expects `mise run lm-local` (llama-server, port 8001); its model id must match the server's --alias. See README 'Configuring the cascade LM'.
